leadText:
Pokémon Hills (Japanese: ポケモンヒルズ Pokémon Hills) is an -exclusive location in Unova, and one of the settings of Genesect and the Legend Awakened. It is a park located at the center of New Tork City specially constructed for the housing of .

Pokémon Hills has a number of different environments that are suitable for the many kinds of Pokémon living there. It also has a hedge maze. According to Eric, the area surrounding Pokémon Hills has plants from all over the .

During the , the Genesect Army invaded Pokémon Hills thinking the park was their home and forced all the Pokémon to leave so that they could build a giant nest. Later, the Pokémon from Pokémon Hills returned and had a big fight with the Genesect Army. The battle ended after took the to the atmosphere and explained that humans and Pokémon live together in the Pokémon world and are friends with them. After that, found the perfect place for the Genesect Army to live in Absentia Natural Park, where Panna Lotuses—flowers that have been around since the Genesect were last alive—bloom in abundance.
